name: FLUX.1 [schnell]

prompt.note: The token limit is T5's max_sequence_length for schnell; CLIP-L still reads 77 tokens.

negative_prompt.note: The card samples with guidance 0 and sd.cpp at cfg 1: CFG off, so a negative prompt has no effect.

resolution.note: The sources give no native size, so none is listed. The multiple of 16 is the research's, shared with FLUX.1 [dev].

sampling.cfg.note: The card's guidance 0 is CFG off; sd.cpp writes CFG off as cfg 1.

warnings.message: FLUX.1 [schnell] runs without CFG at its recommended settings, so the negative prompt has no effect.
FLUX.1 [schnell] is made for 1 to 4 steps; more rarely helps.

notes: CFG: the card's guidance 0 and sd.cpp's cfg 1 both mean CFG off; the profile uses sd.cpp's convention. The card's guidance 0 is its only guidance value, so distilled guidance is not set.
Steps: the card and sd.cpp agree on 4.
Steps above 4 are a warning rather than a constraint: the card recommends 1 to 4 but more steps still run.
